data.name: Balinder
data.long_meaning: Balinder is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'bal' (strength) and 'indra' (lord). This name is believed to signify a brave and powerful individual who is revered and respected. In Hindu mythology, Indra is the god of rain, thunderbolts, and war, and is known for his courage and might. Thus, the name Balinder embodies the qualities of both strength and leadership.
